Control.description: A gate or a limit on a link.

at.description: The end of the link where it sits.

Finding.description:
A problem the pass found, with the capability that fixes it and the
question filed for the owner.

fix.description: The capability that fixes it, and how.

id.description:
Stable id: the kind, a dash and the first 8 hex digits of the sha256
of the paths joined by newlines.

kind.description: What kind of problem it is.

paths.description: The changes, tasks or records the finding concerns, by path.

question.description: The question filed for the owner, by path.

Link.description: A change that must land before another.

after.description: The change that lands after it, by path.

before.description: The change that lands first, by path.

project.description: The id of the project that holds both.

lines.description: How many lines of code it holds.

Project.description: A project: a goal with the changes and tasks that serve it.

changes.description: The open changes of the project, by path.

order.description:
Pairs of changes of this project, the first landing before the
second.

questions.description: The open questions of the project, by path.

realm.description: The id of the realm the project belongs to.

summary.description: Where the work stands and what comes next.

task.description:
The task that tracks the project, by path, or null when none does.
The field is always present, so that null can say there is none.

tasks.description: The open tasks of the project that no change of it does, by path.

title.description: What the project is for, in a few words.

QuestionRules.description:
How an open question is placed on a project, and which realm counts a
question that no rule places. The first rule that matches wins: a change
the question names, then a task, then the project name in its path.

localDefault.description: The realm id of every other question of the board itself.

localRealm.description:
The realm id of the questions of each project folder of the board
itself, by folder name.

mount_realms.description: The realm id of each mounted board's questions, by mount name.

names.description:
The project id for each project folder, as `<folder>` or
`<mount>/<folder>`.

id.description: The realm's id, a short word such as `board`.

title.description: The realm's name as a page shows it.

System.description: A repository or service, as the agent surveyed it.

crates_from.description: The mount whose Cargo workspace `keeper.render` reads for crates.

external.description:
Whether the system is outside the repositories, such as a cloud
service that only links reach.

id.description: The system's id. A repository's id is its mount's name.

language.description: The language it is written in.

links.description: The links that start at this system.

modules.description: The parts of the system that the survey found.

realm.description: The id of the realm it belongs to.

title.description: The system's name as a page shows it.

SystemLink.description:
A link from a system, or one of its modules, to another system or
module.

controls.description: Gates and limits on the link.

module.description: The module of this system where the link starts.

name.description: What the link carries, in a few words.

production.description: Whether the link runs in production.

to.description: The other end: a system id, or `<system>.<module>`.

traffic.description: How busy the link is, from 1 to 10.

TaskRule.description: A rule that ties a question to a project by a task path.

to.description: The id of the project the question belongs to.

description:
`keeper/map/v1`: a consolidation pass's project tree, its findings and,
when the pass surveyed them, the systems the work touches. Phase, touched
date and pull request come from `changes.open` and the change records,
not from this record.

date.description: The UTC day of the pass.

dedupe.description:
Each path through a doubly mounted repository, with the path it
duplicates.

findings.description: What the pass found that needs the owner or an agent to act.

links.description: Orderings between changes of different projects.

projects.description: The project tree: every open change is in exactly one project.

question_rules.description: How the status board places an open question on a project.

questions_waiting.description: How many questions wait on the owner, by realm id.

realms.description: The groups that projects belong to, such as one per board or team.

source.description: The curation record this map was built from.

systems.description:
The repositories and services the work touches, from the agent's
survey of each.

title: KeeperMap
